storyCards.headline: Daydream Believer: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Monkees's "Daydream Believer" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Monkees' Greatest Hits" (1986) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Monkees' Greatest Hits (1986).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
